title: 第344章 清查收获第345章 其他人
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
lines: 林奇四人一同踏入哥布林村庄，
诺大的村落里空荡荡的，连一只残余的哥布林都看不到。
经过先前的大战，哥布林们早已逃得无影无踪，连家园都弃之不顾。
四人也不客气，直接霸占了哥布林首领的石屋。
这石屋虽说依旧简陋，但在整个村庄里已是顶配般的存在。
“快快快，杰克，赶紧拿出来让我看看都有什么宝贝！”
林奇刚坐下，就迫不及待的看着杰克，连休息的心思都没有。
杰克也不拖沓，麻利地从储物卡中取出几个华丽的箱子。
“哇塞！”
“这箱子连外皮都镶钻着宝石，里面肯定有宝贝。”
梅比斯眼前一亮，双脚一蹬就扑在一个箱子上，死死抱着不撒手。
“林奇，这次可是我找到了杰克，带着安琪拉姐姐去救的你，我必须要拥有一个宝箱。”
梅比斯仰着小脸，语气带着几分撒娇和强硬。
林奇无奈地翻了个白眼，“你这小家伙，解救团长还要报酬了？那我救了你多少次了，你怎么不说给我点好处，反倒跟我讨价还价？”
“不嘛不嘛，我就要宝箱，我就要！”
梅比斯见林奇不肯松口，直接撒泼打滚，抱着箱子死死不肯松手。
安琪拉和杰克看着这一幕，皆是笑而不语，想看看小气的团长能不能放放血，满足梅比斯的小要求。
林奇上前想将梅比斯和宝箱分开，结果这小丫头竟然直接动用了龙鳞的力量，哪怕林奇是御卡大师，也拗不过她。
他无奈地叹了口气：“行吧行吧，服了你了，你抱着的这个箱子就归你了，快打开看看，里面到底是什么宝贝。”
“嘿嘿，林奇你最好啦。”
梅比斯脸上立刻换上灿烂的笑容，搓了搓小手，眼神里满是期待。
她小心翼翼地伸手，打开了宝箱的锁扣。
咔嚓！
锁扣应声而开，一抹刺眼的光芒从箱子里迸发而出，晃得众人下意识眯起了眼睛。
可下一秒，
众人脸上的笑容和眼中的期待，全都僵在了脸上。
箱子里的东西的确能让人眼前一亮，但也仅仅是“亮”而已。
除了一堆泛着红光的石头之外，好像并没有什么东西了。
梅比斯张着小嘴，一脸不可置信。
“怎么会是矿石呢？这么华丽的宝箱，你竟然给我装一堆矿石？我不信！”
content_en:
Lynch and the four of them stepped into the goblin village together.
The village of Nuoda was deserted, not even a single remaining goblin could be seen.
After the previous battle, the goblins had already fled without a trace, even abandoning their homes.
The four of them were not polite and directly occupied the goblin leader's stone house.
Although this stone house is still simple and simple, it is already the best in the entire village.
"Quick, quick, quick, Jack, take it out quickly and let me see what treasures there are!"
As soon as Lynch sat down, he couldn't wait to look at Jack, without even thinking about taking a rest.
Jack didn't hesitate and quickly took out several gorgeous boxes from the storage card.
"Wow!"
"Even the outer cover of this box is inlaid with diamonds. There must be treasures inside."
Mabius's eyes lit up, he kicked off his feet and threw himself on a box, holding on tightly and not letting go.
"Lynch, this time I found Jack and took Sister Angela to rescue you. I must have a treasure chest."
Mavis raised her little face, her tone a bit coquettish and tough.
Lin Qi rolled his eyes helplessly, "You little guy, you still need to be rewarded for rescuing the team leader? Then how many times have I rescued you? Why don't you say you will give me some benefits, but instead bargain with me?"
"No, no, I want the treasure chest, I want it!"
Seeing that Lynch refused to let go, Mabius rolled around and hugged the box and refused to let go.
Angela and Jack watched this scene, both smiling and saying nothing, wanting to see if the stingy leader could bleed out and satisfy Mavis's little request.
Lin Qi stepped forward to separate Mavis from the treasure chest, but the little girl actually directly used the power of the dragon scales. Even if Lin Qi was a master of card manipulation, he could not defeat her.
He sighed helplessly: "Okay, okay, I've convinced you, the box you are holding is yours. Open it quickly and see what kind of treasure is inside."
"Hey, Lynch, you're the best."
Mavis immediately put on a bright smile on his face, rubbed his hands, his eyes full of expectation.
She carefully reached out and opened the lock of the treasure chest.
Click!
The lock opened in response, and a dazzling light burst out from the box, causing everyone to subconsciously squint their eyes.
But the next second,
The smiles on everyone's faces and the anticipation in their eyes were all frozen on their faces.
The things in the box are indeed eye-catching, but they are only "bright".
There seemed to be nothing left except a pile of reddish stones.
"Ore, ore??"
Mavis opened his mouth with a look of disbelief.
"How could it be ore? In such a gorgeous treasure chest, you actually put a bunch of ore in it for me? I don't believe it!"
